description: This Java class 'BookUtils' provides utility methods for handling Book objects, such as combining title and series information.

classes.name: BookUtils
classes.description: Utility class for Book-related operations, including combining title and series info.

methods.name: combineTitleAndSeries
methods.description: Returns combined title and series info for a book, if available.

methods.name: bookHasSeriesPosition
methods.description: Checks if the book has a valid series position.

methods.name: addSeriesToTitle
methods.description: Creates an optional string with series info appended to the title.
